name: @fyeeme/pi-review
description: Review & cleanup extension for pi. Registers /code-review and /simplify commands plus a general-purpose `subagent` tool that spawns parallel pi subprocesses — providing the real fan-out capability the code-review-v3 and simplify-v2 skills (auto-loaded from ~/.pi/agent/skills/) need for their multi-agent flows. The /simplify handler uses ctx.getContextUsage() to decide parallel vs single-pass mode deterministically.
author: fyeeme
